brief:
Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has ordered the dismantling of unauthorized settler outposts in the West Bank, according to two people familiar with the matter, Al-Monitor reported. The directive comes as the United States has pressed Israel to act against illegal settlements in the territory.

The sources did not specify a timeline for implementation or which outposts would be targeted under the order. Netanyahu's move signals a shift in approach to the longstanding issue of settlement expansion, though enforcement of such directives has historically faced obstacles from settler resistance and political complications within Israel's government.

title: Netanyahu orders removal of unauthorized West Bank settler outposts
